overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The Board's litigation-strategy executive sessions were proper under Purpose 3 with the chair's declarations, so the appeal vote could be taken in executive session. The Rule of Necessity claim was declined as outside c. 30A, §§ 18-25. The complaint was resolved by informal action with no orders.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Select Board improperly voted in executive session on whether to file an appeal of a Civil Service Commission decision in a firefighter reinstatement matter.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law as the Board's vote to file the appeal was not required to take place in open session.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board violated the Rule of Necessity. The AG said that even if true it would not violate G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.
allegations.key_passage: We note that, even if true, this allegation would not constitute a violation of G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25. Accordingly, we decline to review it.
